mathematical_audit.literal_source: Python source_base_weights is the finite binomial/factorial formula behind HermiteBernstein.leftCoefficient; source coefficients are exp(-1)*base[r]+base[d-r], d=2k+1. Existing sourceInterpolant_bernstein relates this literal row to sourceInterpolant(k).eval(t-1), not a replacement polynomial fitted to the diagnostics.
mathematical_audit.coordinate_and_chronology: N=2^n, R=pi*L, lo=R*(N-2b)/N and hi=R*(N-2a)/N. Reflect source coefficients c[d-r], right-restrict at lo, left-restrict at z=(hi-lo)/(1-lo), then reverse final coefficients. The resulting evaluation is P(-hi+(hi-lo)*y). Substituting y=(j-a)/(b-a) gives P(-R+2R*j/N). Physical j and output labels are not reflected. Offsets near zero remain rational rather than forming 1 minus a tiny radius at fixed Decimal precision.
mathematical_audit.offset_interval_domain: R,N,a,b are real; hypotheses are R>0,N>0,a>=0,a<b,2b<=N and active hi<=1. It concludes 0<=lo<hi<=1. The unused a>=0 binder is stronger than needed by this proof but follows from the physical domain; it is not an extra scientific promise.
mathematical_audit.grid_provider_domain: offset_grid_source_eval has k:Nat and R,N,a,b,j:Real, requiring only N!=0,b-a!=0,lo!=1 for the exact polynomial identity. It does not itself prove active cutoff, membership of j in [a,b], or correctness of a Python TT/circuit.
mathematical_audit.normalized_parameter_domain: R<=S,A>=0,B-A>=0,S*A<1 imply both positive denominators and monotonicity of R*(B-A)/(1-R*A). Actual physical A,B and rational pi enclosure must supply these internal conditions; they are not assumed as independent SourceAnchors.
mathematical_audit.convex_enclosure: For t in [0,1], coefficient weights are nonnegative. Lower and upper affine functions attain their interval extrema at parameter endpoints. min of two lower evaluations and max of two upper evaluations therefore enclose every convex value, including signed coefficients and singleton intervals, without treating 1-t and t as independent interval variables.
mathematical_audit.interval_rows: intervalRows is a literal recursion on real endpoint pairs, not executable Fraction code. intervalRows_sound composes the convex lemma with initial coefficient memberships for every j<=i+d. This sufficient finite initial prefix is stronger than the minimal i..i+d cone when i>0; it is an INTERNAL_PROOF_INPUT, not discharged scalar-source membership.
mathematical_audit.rounding: interval_rounding_error requires true x in [lo,hi] and gives |stored-x|<=max(|stored-lo|,|stored-hi|). Stored need not lie in the interval and may be zero or have another sign. Python implements the endpoint distances using Fraction.from_float, so the actual IEEE float dyadic is measured, not an ideal midpoint or intended real number.
mathematical_audit.remaining_scalar_bridge: Machin pi bounds and alternating exp(-1) partial sums have standard analytic enclosure justifications. Actual initial/source/parameter membership and embedding of every Python rational operation/list traversal into the Lean recurrence are not newly proved. Conditional real interval lemmas do not close that executable refinement.

own_executed_checks.independent_reference_method: Endpoint Hermite jets, not producer coefficient/subdivision functions: for d=2k+1, w_s=1/(d falling s)-sum_{r<s}(-1)^(s-r)*choose(s,r)*w_r. Set c_s=exp(-1)*w_s and c_(d-s)=w_s for s<=k. Convert Bernstein to monomials, substitute t=1-pi*L*(N-2a)/N + (2*pi*L*(b-a)/N)*y, and convert monomials back to degree-d Bernstein. pi was independently evaluated by 12 Gauss-Legendre iterations; exp(-1) by Decimal.exp. Only certificate production calls the new producer.

totality_epsilon_and_cost_boundaries.input_domain: Actual constructor accepts n>=1,k>=0,positive Fraction L; natural/integer typing is used by shifts and loops. This audit does not cover n=0, arbitrary real input encoding, or all legal finite inputs. Tiny L is not silently removed from the intended scientific family.
totality_epsilon_and_cost_boundaries.retry: Default local schedule is at most five attempts with scalar term counts doubled each attempt. Geometry rejection refines and retries; exhausted geometry or local precision budget raises, never emits a substitute source. The near-cutoff test succeeds at 32 terms after rejection at 16 and fails honestly with a one-attempt cap. Frozen cutoff searches only 8..512 pi terms; no uniform bit-dependent separation guarantee is supplied.
totality_epsilon_and_cost_boundaries.arbitrary_epsilon: Local tolerance 1/10^14 is not global epsilon. Arbitrarily small local positive tolerances cannot generally be met by the fixed float64 representation; the explicit 1/10^40 test fails after two attempts. This fixed-backend limitation and bounded separation requirement are not an impossibility theorem for arbitrary-precision approximation or Hermite preparation.
totality_epsilon_and_cost_boundaries.nonfinite: Local stored_interval_error rejects inf/nan, and Fraction-to-float overflow can throw earlier. No all-k coefficient range, uniform successful conversion or whole QR/circuit nonfinite exclusion is proved. Failure is not a successful certificate.
totality_epsilon_and_cost_boundaries.actual_bit_storage: Fractions hold exact finite numerator/denominator integers; actual stored coefficients are IEEE dyadics reconstructed with Fraction.from_float. rational_text/read_rational preserve large certificate bytes with hex fallback. The measured endpoint-bit maximum concerns saved coefficient interval endpoints only, not all intermediate operands or runtime.
totality_epsilon_and_cost_boundaries.classical_work: Literal source weights are recomputed per injection; no shared source cache may be charged implicitly. Two valid de Casteljau triangles use d*(d+1) convex updates per valid attempt. Counters omit source factorial/binomial generation, all integer multiplication/GCD sizes, comparisons, copies, midpoint/float conversions, pi/Taylor generation and serialization. They are not a full operation trace or polynomial bit-time proof.
totality_epsilon_and_cost_boundaries.other_errors_and_resources: Actual free subdivision matrices, Decimal midpoint-pi/exponential cores, direct sums, scaled QR/absorption, computed normalizer, compiler repeated QR, angle computations and serialization all remain charged but uniformly uncertified here. Finite actual RY/CX counts do not certify bit runtime or gate precision. The bond_bound metadata 2k+6 is not newly proved by this audit.
totality_epsilon_and_cost_boundaries.full_state_composition: A complete epsilon theorem still needs source/core delta, relative norm eta and serialized action zeta, then the root's conditional composition such as 2F*delta+eta/(1-eta)+zeta. Local coefficient enclosures alone do not supply these. Tiny local coefficient error near 1e-100 coexists with measured whole-circuit error near 1e-16. No exact rounded garbage-zero theorem, norm-floor closure or phase quotient is inferred from the finite comparisons.
